card.text: Small moon that leads Dione around Saturn from a Lagrange point.

introduction.text: Helene is hundreds of times smaller than Dione. Pierre Laques and Jean Lecacheux found it in 1980.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces shading; terrain in cast shadows is left empty.

false-color.title: Cassini false color
false-color.summary: Infrared and ultraviolet shown in false color across the photographed gullies; shadows remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below an 18 km sphere from the Cassini shape; small craters are not resolved.
